Neighborhood witness statement dated 2024-03-15. I was walking past Lakeside Market around 10:30 PM when I witnessed the armed robbery. The suspect was wearing a black hoodie and had a gun. I immediately called 911 and provided the description to the dispatcher. The suspect fled toward the alley behind the store.
